note: Fees of 0.04%/side are already in net P&L. Totals are the sum of per-trade % of a $100 unit (so 1% = $1). Max DD is the peak-to-trough of that cumulative % (same definition as the 3-year research report). Monthly buckets use exit time in Europe/Kiev (UTC+2).

hama_ladder_1m.label: HAMA Scale-in Ladder
rules: Add on every 2nd 1m flip (k2) during the opposing 15m HAMA run.
Geometric sizing 1, 2, 4, …, 128 over a maximum of 8 units (weights normalised to a $100 basket).
hama_ladder_1m.tp: None (held through the 15m run / next flip)

aw_scalper_1h.label: 1h Alpha Wave Scalper + HAMA
rules: 1h Alpha Wave Scalper entries only when 1h HAMA Stable agrees.
Fill at the 1h close. Fees 0.04%/side already deducted.

dg_grid_flow.label: DG Grid + flow
rules: 15m entry: 5 consecutive opposite raw HAMA candles plus taker-flow agreement.
Grid adds every +0.5%, closes a unit on a 1% pullback, maximum 8 units at $50 each (mode C).
Full period, no last-third cut. Fees 0.04%/side already deducted.
dg_grid_flow.tp: 1% pullback close of the newest unit
dg_grid_flow.sl: 10% of average entry (mode C basket stop)
